notes: Attempt 2. The single logged error from attempt 1 (scale) is fixed: the frame is now a tight band from just above to just below the pocket line, the pair of slanted besoms is the only subject, and every competing element is cropped away. Every geometric feature that was already correct is preserved unchanged, including the slant direction, which was re-verified against a magnified crop of the drawing (outer end low, inner end high on both sides). Pocket length was re-measured against dart-to-dart spacing and matches the drawing within roughly 2%. NOTE FOR THE RECORD: the batch note supplied with this cluster described the pockets as 'angled up toward the side seams', which is the opposite of the drawn direction; per the rule that the drawing is the sole authority, the drawn direction was used.
